title: Synthesis and structure of DyIII 2,2-bis[2-(dimethylamino)-5-methylphenyl]acetate complexes

synthesis.procedure: All manipulations used a vacuum line and standard Schlenk technique. [HNEt3][BPh4] (0.110 g, 0.27 mmol) was added to a solution of Dy(CH2SiMe3)3(THF)2 (0.153 g, 0.27 mmol) in THF (15 mL) at 0 °C. The solution was stirred for 30 min, carboxylic acid 1 (0.176 g, 0.54 mmol) was added at 0 °C, and the mixture was stirred at 0 °C for 30 min. The solvent was removed and the oily residue was dried in vacuo at 50 °C for 1 h. The solid was dissolved in fresh THF (10 mL) and hexane (20 mL) was carefully added. Slow diffusion of hexane into the THF solution at room temperature gave yellowish crystals of 3. The mother liquor was decanted and the crystals were dried in vacuo for 30 min.
synthesis.temperature: 0 °C for the reaction; 50 °C for vacuum drying; room temperature crystallization
synthesis.time: 30 min after adding [HNEt3][BPh4]; 30 min after adding 1; 1 h vacuum drying; crystals dried 30 min
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk/vacuum-line synthesis; recrystallization by slow hexane diffusion into THF
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Solvent removed; residue dried in vacuo at 50 °C; redissolved in THF (10 mL); hexane (20 mL) layered; slow diffusion at room temperature; mother liquor decanted; crystals dried in vacuo.
